limitations: Two constructed workloads plus optional one real upstream fix; not the 100-change/10-project target.
Outer spans include CLI/Node startup, native execution and child-side report/history/source sealing; parent normalization and fixture creation excluded and controller elapsed separately retained.
First plan starts with empty pure analysis cache; repeat retains only that cache and resets history. Shared OS/dependency/native framework caches are uncontrolled; no fully cold-machine claim.
Framework metadata/CLI and core source/Node bytes are bound; imported native dependencies and arbitrary test subprocesses are not fully attested.
Native zero-case selectors can be complete within their chosen scope yet miss a demonstrated fault; such timing is never credited as quality-equivalent speed.

campaignScope.quietWindow: Root/framework/benchmark native processes paused; unrelated machine activity not instrumented.
